protocol.task: For product code LLZ, list this week's change, the non-manufacturer reports, and the recalls citing it, each with its FDA link.
protocol.who: Same person for both runs (Charan), screen-recorded.
manual_steps: Open open.fda.gov device event search and accessdata.fda.gov MAUDE; filter product code LLZ, the latest week on openFDA and the 4 weeks before.
Copy counts by event type into Excel and work out the change.
Filter report source to non-manufacturer (user facility, voluntary, distributor); copy each report number and its MAUDE link.
Search the recall database for LLZ; copy recall numbers, reasons and links that cite the failure.
Stop the clock when the sheet holds all three lists with links.
maudesignal_steps: Open /investigate, enter LLZ and the problem; read the non-manufacturer section and recalls.
Open /signals for this week's change for LLZ.
Export the note to file / CSV from the evidence pack.
Stop the clock when the export holds all three lists with links.
protocol.rules: Timed twice, same person, same code, same day, screen-recorded; the recording file name goes in notes. If MaudeSignal is slower, record it as slower. Minutes are never turned into money here; the buyer types their own analyst cost in the calculator.
